name: Safe-DER-RTA
description: Safe-DER-RTA v1.0.0 --- Reproducibility Release Overview This release provides the complete reproducibility package accompanying the study: "Assurance-Governed Autonomous Flexibility Dispatch in Renewable-Rich Distribution Networks under Uncertainty." Safe-DER-RTA evaluates an autonomous distributed-energy-resource (DER) flexibility dispatch architecture in which an economic proposal layer is separated from a runtime-assurance (RTA) layer that evaluates the proposed action against AC power-flow constraints and may Approve, Modify, or Reject + execute a best-effort fallback. The release freezes the code, experiment configurations, raw and derived results, diagnostic ablations, trajectory-feasibility analyses, and manuscript-supporting artifacts used for the study. The benchmark uses the IEEE 33-bus distribution network with photovoltaic generation, wind generation, battery energy storage, EV/V2G flexibility, and flexible demand under forecast and profile uncertainty. Release scope Version v1.0.0 consolidates three frozen experimental stages. v0.6.0 --- Main benchmark campaign The primary experiment compares five controllers: passive; rule-based; unconstrained economic dispatch; soft-penalty dispatch; assurance-governed dispatch (assured). The campaign contains: 20 random seeds; 7 operating scenarios; 5 controllers; 700 episodes; 67,200 simulation steps; 96 steps per episode; 15-minute control interval.
